subject: These dates are no longer available – your payment is refunded ({booking_ref})
preheader: Your payment arrived after the reservation of the dates had expired. We are refunding the full amount to your card.
heading: We are sorry, these dates were booked in the meantime
body_html:
{guest_first_name}, your payment for {unit_name} ({arrival_date} – {departure_date}) arrived after the reservation of the dates had expired, and someone else booked them in the meantime.

We have refunded the full amount of {refund_amount} to your card; depending on your bank it shows within 5–10 days.

We apologise for the inconvenience. Another apartment may be free on the same dates:

{cta_button}

We are also happy to help by phone: {business_phone}.

Kind regards,
{business_name}
